## Requirements

CedarKit requires Python ≥ 3.13.

## Install from PyPI

```bash
pip install cedarkit
```

## Install from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jordanplanders/cedar_util.git
cd cedar_util
pip install -e .
```

## Conda environment (recommended)

A pre-configured environment file is provided in `.binder/environment.yml`:

```bash
conda env create -f .binder/environment.yml
conda activate cedar_env
```

## Verify the installation

```python
import cedarkit
```
